title: Compile diagnostics do not yet form a stable debugger failure artifact

minimal_reproducer.program: an invalid .mncs source passed to mncs execute

expected_semantics: A compile failure should be a structured failure with diagnostic identity, source span, compiler phase, and reproducible program/request artifact.
actual_behavior_limitation: The launcher can preserve bounded stderr and process status, but an unsuccessful execute boundary may not emit an execution-result document with a compile classification or structured diagnostic list. The native core can classify compile status only when the adapter has an explicit structured signal.
why_capability_matters: Failure analysis must distinguish source/compile failure from launcher infrastructure failure and connect the diagnostic to the program identity.
current_workaround: Preserve process output/digests, keep infrastructure versus semantic classification distinct, and do not claim a compile failure when the runtime emitted no structured status.

host_language_code_required.classification: temporary adapter caused by an identified MNCS pressure
host_language_code_required.why: The adapter supervises the process and transports stderr; it cannot safely parse prose into compiler semantics.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Ensure compile/validation boundaries emit versioned structured diagnostics with source identity/span, compiler phase, severity, and stable diagnostic identity.
alternatives_considered: classify all nonzero exits as compile failures
resolution_criteria: An invalid source produces a structured compiler failure artifact that the debugger can validate and inspect without parsing terminal prose.

campaign_review.disposition: The invalid-effect fixture produces structured compiler validation and compile_failure witness evidence without terminal diagnostic parsing.
